longDescription:
Quest is where everything you are working on lives — software projects with a dozen repos, and everything else too.

• One model, three levels — projects hold epics, epics hold items, items hold subtasks. Every level below the epic is board-visible and independently tracked.
• Five surfaces — a cross-project Today inbox with quick capture, a project overview with links and activity, a filterable list, a drag-and-drop board, and a timeline with an unscheduled rail so nothing gets lost.
• Per-project status schemes — each project carries its own set of statuses, which drive its board columns and its completion rollups. Completion follows a status's meaning rather than its name. In this release the schemes are the built-in ones (software projects get an In Review column, general projects don't); editing them is not in v0.1.0.
• Built for the assistant — Quest publishes twelve tools over MCP, so the agent files, moves, and queries real work items instead of writing markdown. Deletes are soft and every agent action is logged.
• Connected — link repos, branches, PRs, folders, and documents to any project or item. Multi-repo projects are the normal case.
